verdict.rationale: Reclaim's own docs show it schedules and reschedules Habits, Tasks, Focus Time, buffers and synced calendar copies in the background, and users configure these through goals, priorities and hashtags. However, the background automation is limited to built-in calendar-scheduling behaviors rather than general automations a user can define, and the community corroboration is anecdotal. missing for 10: user-definable custom automation rules or triggers beyond calendar time-blocking, documented recurring background jobs outside scheduling, independent hands-on verification of reliable unattended operation

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Reclaim automatically schedules and reschedules events on your calendar, so you don't have to manually adjust your calendar when conflicts come up.
If a meeting overbooks another lower-priority smart event, Reclaim automatically reschedules it to the next best time. No reshuffling required.
Reclaim will auto-schedule your calendar around the things that are most important.
Synced copies stay up-to-date as the source events change, so you never have to worry about manually updating or adding events across calendars.
By default, Reclaim will automatically lock your Smart Meetings at 4am in your local timezone at the beginning of the day so that they don't move around the day-of.
Reclaim makes me think about my time more, but drag appointment boxes around less.
